item.title: Apple M6 Pro Achieves the Highest Single-Core CPU Score in Geekbench 7
NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation open-Source Geospatial AI Model
item.description:
📝 She served as a planetary science subject-matter expert on the NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model team. Across all three benchmarks, the pretrained NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model matched or outperformed comparison models based on ImageNet pretraining, as well as an architecturally identical model initialized without lunar pretraining. The multimodal design of the NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model allows it to learn relationships among different types of lunar observations rather than treating each dataset independently.
🔗 Read more: https://newsroom.usra.edu/usra-contributes-planetary-science-expertise-to-nasa-ibm-lunar-foundation-model/
